chosen_mechanism: Cofinal mass-balanced short inverse at first unused index v=U+1, complete binomial recombination before compression; all artificial poles and finite return retained.

predictions.P1: Mass balancing leaves the first U coefficients unchanged and the exact Lambda reconstruction through m when (U+1)^K>m.
predictions.P2: The complete repaired germ has no pole of order >=2; its simple residue is 1-(1-b_U)^K.
predictions.P3: Using actual Mobius divisor identity and squarefree support yields |1-b_U|<=4/5 for U>=64 with U|a_U|<=1/2.
predictions.P4: The finite signed remainder is not controlled by the local pole bound; its exact return restores C0 with coefficient one.
